entities.summary: Elizabeth Taylor  was an American artist, journalist, botanist, and traveler. Her travel essays from Alaska, Canada, Iceland, the Faroe Islands and Norway were published in Frank Leslie's Popular Monthly, Atlantic Monthly, Forest and Stream and others. Some of her essays are published in The Far Islands and Other Cold Places (ISBN 1-880654-11-3). Whilst in Norway, Taylor had discovered two new species of flowers and two new species of insects.
